SELECT c.id, c.material_id, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, c.level, c.freq, c.calc_date FROM wms_abc_class c LEFT JOIN base_material m ON m.id = c.material_id WHERE c.deleted = 0
AND c.level = #{q.level}
AND (m.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY c.freq DESC, c.id
SELECT material_id, COUNT(*) AS freq FROM inv_movement WHERE deleted = 0 AND qty < 0 AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{daysBack} DAY) GROUP BY material_id ORDER BY freq DESC, material_id
SELECT level, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM wms_abc_class WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY level
SELECT DISTINCT s.warehouse_id FROM inv_stock s JOIN wms_abc_class c ON c.material_id = s.material_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND c.level = #{level}
